title: SALES REPRESENTATIVE,
description: SALES REPRESENTATIVE, Rock Solid Plastics Limited Kingston and St. Andrew Negotiable Not disclosed Updated 20/11/2026 Director Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save This role sells RSPL's own plastic products alongside hardware lines (plumbing, electrical, building materials, tools, and paint,). The role serves trade and walk-in customers and wins accounts in the field. We want a results-driven, customer-focused person with an entrepreneurial mindset. Core Functions/Duties/Responsibilities 1. Sales and business development •               Meet or exceed assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the territory and product categories. •               Plan a daily schedule to visit and call existing and prospective customers, and present, promote and sell RSPL products with clear, solid arguments. •               Find and pursue new business: hardware stores, contractors, builders, plumbers, electricians, farmers, property developers, schools, hotels and government agencies. •               Generate leads, follow up promptly and turn prospects into repeat accounts. •               Cross-sell and upsell RSPL's own manufactured plastic products with complementary hardware lines. •               Prepare quotations and tenders, and submit sales contracts and orders for approval. 2. Customer and account management •               Build and keep strong, long-term relationships with trade and retail customers to secure future sales. •               Tell customers about products, prices, promotions, availability and credit terms. •               Resolve customer queries, complaints and returns quickly, and escalate where needed, to keep satisfaction high. •               Keep customer records and contact history up to date in the company's sales or CRM system. •               Seek customer feedback and use it to improve service. 3. Superstore and retail support •               Serve walk-in and trade customers on the superstore floor during assigned shifts, especially peak periods and promotions. •               Help with merchandising, product displays, shelf pricing and signage so the store meets RSPL standards. •               Help plan and run promotions, product launches, in-store events, trade days and exhibitions. •               Advise customers on product selection, specifications, quantities and installation basics for hardware and building projects. •               Report stock shortages, slow-moving lines and damaged goods to the Superstore Supervisor and Procurement. 4. Orders, delivery, credit and collections •               Complete all sales paperwork and system entries correctly and on time, including orders, invoices and credit applications. •               Check stock with the warehouse and production team, estimate delivery dates and arrange delivery schedules. •               Follow RSPL's credit policy and check customer credit limits before confirming orders. •               Collect deposits and outstanding balances from customers on time, and help Accounts Receivable recover overdue debts. •               Handle cash, cheques and payment documents according to company controls. 5. Market intelligence and reporting •               Monitor competitors' pricing, products, new launches, delivery schedules, credit terms and merchandising. •               Submit daily call reports, weekly work plans, monthly sales reports and annual territory analyses. •               Report on customer needs, problems and interests, and on the potential for new products and services. •               Recommend changes to products, pricing, services and policies based on results and market trends. 6. Product knowledge and professional development •               Learn RSPL's products, processes, pricing and promotion guidelines thoroughly, including technical features and benefits. •               Keep up with hardware, construction and building-supplies trends. •               Attend training, workshops and supplier product sessions, and apply what you learn. 7. Teamwork, compliance and conduct •               Work with sales colleagues and other departments on joint sales efforts, large orders and customer service. •               Follow company policies, health and safety rules, and anti-fraud and cash-handling controls. •               Look after any company property or samples you are given. •               Represent RSPL professionally at all times and keep a positive, team-focused attitude. •               Carry out any other reasonable duties your manager assigns in line with the role. This job description sets out the main duties of the role. It does not list every task. Management may change it to meet business needs, after consulting the job holder. Required Skills •               Selling and negotiation: Strong selling, persuasion and negotiation skills; able to close deals and handle objections •               Communication: Excellent spoken and written communication; able to tailor and deliver presentations to different audiences •               Customer focus: Puts the customer first; builds trust and long-term relationships; open to feedback •               Drive and results: Highly motivated, competitive and target-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset •               Organisation: Good at prioritising, managing time and planning a territory; accurate with paperwork •               Product and technical aptitude: Quick to learn plastics and hardware products, and able to explain specifications and uses •               Numeracy: Confident with pricing, discounts, margins, quotations and basic sales maths •               Technology: Good working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); comfortable with point-of-sale, CRM and mobile ordering tools •               Teamwork: A team player who works well with other departments •               Adaptability: Works well in a fast-paced, changing start-up environment •               Integrity: Honest and trustworthy in handling cash, credit and customer information Key Performance Indicators Performance is reviewed monthly against targets that the Sales Manager sets for each period. •               Sales revenue (Monthly): Actual sales against target (J$), by territory and category •               New accounts (Monthly): Number of new active trade accounts opened •               Customer coverage (Weekly): Planned customer visits and calls completed •               Gross margin (Monthly): Margin achieved against the price list, with discounts kept within approved limits •               Collections (Monthly): Percentage of balances collected within credit terms, and debtor days •               Cross-selling (Quarterly): Share of sales that include RSPL-manufactured products •               Customer satisfaction (Quarterly): Complaints resolved within the agreed time, and customer feedback •               Reporting (Weekly / monthly): Call reports, work plans and territory reports submitted on time and accurately Educational Requirements, Qualifications & Experience Required •               At least five (5) CSEC/CXC General Proficiency passes, including Mathematics and English Language. •               An associate degree or diploma in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience. •               At least two (2) years' proven sales experience, with a record of meeting targets. •               A valid Jamaican driver's licence and a clean driving record. •               Your own reliable motor vehicle in good working condition, for field travel. •               A valid Police Record, and satisfactory references. Preferred •               A BSc in Sales and Marketing, Business Administration or equivalent. •               Three (3) or more years' sales experience in a large commercial, industrial or manufacturing company. •               Experience selling hardware, building materials, plumbing, electrical or construction supplies, or in a superstore or retail setting. •               An existing network of contractors, builders or hardware retailers in Jamaica. •               Training in customer service, professional selling or credit and collections. Working Conditions & Physical Requirements •               The role mixes field travel with time on the superstore floor and in the office. •               The job holder will drive daily and visit customer sites, including construction sites and farms. They must wear the required personal protective equipment (PPE) on site. •               They must be able to stand and walk for long periods during store shifts. •               They must be able to lift and move product samples and display items of up to 23 kg (50 lb), using safe lifting practices. •               Some work on Saturdays, public holidays, evenings and at trade events will be needed during peak periods and promotions.
